rationale: The P4 GPU-audio raw trace writer adds shared-memory audio timing and transfer instrumentation under core/render and core/gpu_audio. The render selector is crossed because the instrumentation records Dawn/Metal submission and completion stages; it does not change renderer behavior, GPU resource ownership, assets, fonts, Skia pins, or the framework authority boundary. The writer is a diagnostic and evidence surface only, and the raw performance verdict remains unassigned until a GPU-enabled realtime campaign produces an authenticated receipt. Registered as watch-only so the family coverage remains explicit without moving authority to Vellum.
